headline: Senior Program Manager  |  Platform Delivery & Cloud Migration  |  PMP  |  PSM

summary.text: Senior program manager who takes logistics and cloud platform work from plan to launch across up to 9 engineering teams. Keeps each effort on one plan, one dependency map, and one status review, so builders stay focused and leadership sees risk early. Results: 140 services migrated 6 weeks early, 61% weekly use of an AI coding assistant among 320 engineers, and production rollbacks cut from 7 to 2 a year.

deliberateGaps.Kubernetes: Nice-to-have in the JD. Not in the bank: Alex coordinated the cloud migration but never operated container platforms. Carried instead: the 140-service migration across 9 teams.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
bullets: Moved 140 warehouse services to the cloud across 9 engineering teams, finishing 6 weeks ahead of an 18-month plan.
Ran a release readiness review for 22 quarterly releases, and production rollbacks fell from 7 in the first year to 2 in the second.
Took an AI coding assistant to 61% weekly active use among 320 engineers within 5 months, tracked on a monthly adoption dashboard.
Replaced 4 separate status reports with one weekly program review, cutting reporting time for team leads from 3 hours to 1 hour per week.
Managed a $2.3M annual vendor budget across 3 carrier-integration partners and renegotiated 2 contracts for a 12% cost reduction.
